skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the general issues of urban areas, the role of urban and regional planning in sustainable urban development, and the integration of urban and regional planning models.
Understand the differences between urban and rural planning, the role of regional planning in urban development, and the integration of regional planning models.
Analyze and apply urban and regional planning theories in specific situations, learn from urban planning experiences in other countries, and apply these lessons to Vietnamese cities.
Analyze and apply urban land use planning theories and models in urbanization processes.
Analyze and apply urban construction planning theories and models in urbanization processes.
Analyze and apply urban environmental planning theories and models in urbanization processes.
Develop research skills, including information gathering, analysis, and synthesis from various sources.
Work effectively in groups, including task distribution, collaboration, and presentation skills.
Apply critical thinking skills to analyze urban and regional planning issues and develop solutions.
Communicate effectively, including presenting research findings and participating in discussions.
Develop self-learning and research skills to continue advancing in the field of urban and regional planning.
